planets.name: K2-32 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-32 with a 20.7-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-32 c was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around K2-32. Its orbit and size follow Lillo-Box et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
